name: Carlos Barahona
title: Founder and Strategic Advisor
long_description: Carlos is Founder and Strategic Advisor at Stats4SD. He works with partners and clients on complex research design and robust methodologies in the context of sustainable development. With over 30 years’ experience, he specialises in quantitative methods, participatory action research and mixed methods. He is passionate about transdisciplinary research that combines scientific rigour with local knowledge. His work focuses on enabling communities, researchers and organisations to produce and use evidence to guide change, with a strong emphasis on knowledge co-creation in support of agroecology, farmer-led research and food systems transformation. Carlos contributes to strategic thinking and external engagement, including as part of the leadership team of the McKnight Foundation’s Global Collaboration for Resilient Food Systems (CRFS). Before founding Stats4SD in 2016, he worked for 21 years at the Statistical Services Centre, University of Reading.

name: Richard (Ric) Coe
title: Co-Founder and Strategic Advisor
long_description: Ric is Co-Founder and Strategic Advisor at Stats4SD. He advises project teams, partners and clients on the design and planning of research, particularly in sub-Saharan Africa. He has extensive experience supporting research on food systems, agriculture and the natural environment, with a focus on agroforestry and agroecology. His work draws on expertise in experimental design, farmer-centred research, systems approaches and assessment. Ric contributes to methodological development and strategic thinking across projects. He has been part of the research methods support programme for the McKnight Foundation’s Global Collaboration for Resilient Food Systems (CRFS) since 2009 and is a member of its leadership team. Before co-founding Stats4SD, Ric was a lecturer in applied statistics at the University of Reading. He also works with CIFOR-ICRAF (World Agroforestry Centre), supporting research teams with methods.

name: Andrew Pinney
title: Co-Founder and Strategic Advisor
long_description: Andrew is Co-Founder and Strategic Advisor at Stats4SD. He supports project teams, partners and clients on monitoring, evaluation and impact assessment in international development. ith over 35 years’ experience, his expertise includes statistical methods, household surveys, resilience measurement and the evaluation of international aid programmes. His work has a particular focus on crisis-affected and post-conflict contexts, including Afghanistan, Somalia, Ethiopia and Sudan. Andrew contributes to methodological development and strategic advisory work across projects, particularly in relation to impact evaluation and evidence use. He recently led the award-winning IMPACT Study evaluating a joint programme of the European Union and the International Organization for Migration supporting migrant reintegration in the Horn of Africa.
